title: Baƙi Masu Ban Mamaki na Birni Mai Ganuwa
intro: Wata ƙungiya ta isa ƙofofin wani birni wanda mutanensa ba su taɓa sanin gaskiya ba. Sun kawo saƙo, amma mazaunan suka zama masu adawa da juna, suna barazanar tashin hankali. Duk da haka, daga wani wuri da ba a zata ba, wata murya ɗaya ta tashi don kare baƙi, ta shirya wani muhimmin lamari.
clues: Mun shiga wani birni wanda mutanensa suka nutse cikin rashin imani.
Suka kalle mu da tuhuma suka ce, 'Ku dai kawai halittu ne na yau da kullun kamar mu.'
Mun yi musu gargaɗi, amma suka ɗaga mana duwatsu.
Wani mutum ya yi sauri daga mafi nisa na birnin don ya tabbatar da gaskiyarmu.
Ya sanar da mutanensa, 'Me yasa ba zan bauta wa wanda ya halicce ni ba?'
Karyata birnin ya ƙare da bugu ɗaya, kuma shiru ya mamaye inda suka taɓa yin ba'a.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai zafi
Gwaji na haƙuri da yaro da ya ɓace

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An lalata birnin da ihu ɗaya tilo
Teku ya rabu ya nutsar da rundunar
Wutar ta yi sanyi kuma ta yi aminci
Kifin ya mayar da mutumin bakin teku
outcome.answer: An lalata birnin da ihu ɗaya tilo

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
